source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (echarts.js) under node, svg painter typed canvas, ssr init then _ssr = false, env.node = false
notes: A frame: due timers, NOW += 16, zr.animation.update(), zr._flush(false).
A pointer or action step: NOW += 1000, the handler or dispatchAction, _onframe with scheduler.unfinished held false.

cases.note: a scatter of 3500 symbols drawn at once (progressive 0): past the threshold, a hovered symbol is drawn again over all in its emphasis style, its own copy unchanged (no scale, no z2)
[r2v] past the threshold, a symbol highlighted, then a dataZoom (a full update) while it is held: after the update it is on the hover layer still, its own copy at rest

[r2v] a scatter of 3500 zoomed to half (under the threshold): a symbol highlighted takes its emphasis scale in its own layer; the zoom back to the whole (past the threshold) keeps it so; a select while held puts it on the hover layer with its own layer as it was -- scaled
the same scatter with 1500 symbols: under the threshold, the symbol itself takes the state (scale, z2, lifted fill)
hoverLayerThreshold 1000 at the root: 1500 symbols are past it
past the threshold, a declared emphasis style and scale: the style is the hover copy's, the scale nobody's
past the threshold, an emphasis label: the symbol has a textContent and never uses the hover layer
two scatters of 2000: the count is the chart's, both series use the hover layer; highlight both
past the threshold, focus series: the blur is no hover state -- the other series repaint in their layer, the hovered symbol is on the hover layer
a progressive scatter of 2000 by 500 (threshold 1000): every symbol an incremental render made carries the flag, under the count threshold
a progressive heatmap of 1200 cells by 300: incremental rects use the hover layer
the same heatmap drawn at once: under the threshold, no hover layer
a bar of 3200 categories (not large): past the threshold; select while held, then downplay -- the own layer keeps the style it had when the bar entered the hover layer

[r2v] the same bars, the select style with a border: a bar selected, then hovered (its own layer keeps the select style), then unselected while held -- the hover style is the normal style under emphasis, no border, whatever the own layer still shows
a parallel series of 3200 lines drawn at once: no incremental flag (ParallelView sets none), the threshold puts a highlighted line on the hover layer
the same lines by 400: the threshold once the chunks are in
[r2v] the same lines by 400, highlighted before the second chunk: the storage holds the first chunk alone, under the threshold -- the line takes the state in its own layer
a declared emphasis lineStyle on the hover layer
hoverLayerThreshold 1, a pie whose labels show only on emphasis (the default): a textContent all the same, no hover layer
hoverLayerThreshold 1, a pie with no label in any state: PiePiece gives every sector a textContent, so never the hover layer
hoverLayerThreshold 1, a pie with its labels: every sector has a textContent, no hover layer
hoverLayerThreshold 1, a line: its symbol and its polyline on the hover layer (the line's emphasis width is the hover copy's)
[r2v] five symbols and nothing else in the storage (the axes hidden), hoverLayerThreshold 5: the count must pass the threshold (elCount > value) -- five is not past five
[r2v] the same symbols, hoverLayerThreshold 4: five is past it
hoverLayerThreshold 1, a treemap: preventUsingHoverLayer
